cues: The ceramic planter has drainage holes that keep excess water from pooling around the roots.
A granite countertop resists scratches, though acidic spills can dull its polished surface.
The folding ladder locks into place with crossbars that prevent its sides from spreading.
Fresh snow muffles footsteps and softens the edges of fences across the field.
An old lighthouse stands on a rocky promontory, its white paint peeling in strips.
